design_authority: docs/us_short_system_design.md §4.2 analyst-revision component / §5.2 collective-downgrade basis / §3 low-trust source boundary / §18.2 schema-first consumption
authorization_note: OFFLINE contract shape only. Live yfinance fetch is separately gated and low-trust. yfinance analyst grades may only feed the advisory analyst-grades component; it never gates weekly emit, provider-health criticality, production readiness, DataHub, or ship-gate evidence.
recency_window_basis: calendar days before as_of. This is the same reviewed recent-analyst-sentiment prior used by the FMP grades resolver and is not validated alpha.
direction_note: Use yfinance's own Action field only: up -> up, down -> down, every other action including init/main/reit/unknown -> neutral. Do not rank ToGrade/FromGrade strings.

summary_contract.note: The output shape is byte-compatible with engine.us_short_fmp_analyst_grades.resolve_analyst_grade_actions: analyst_actions_recent drives §4.2 and distinct_downgrading_firms drives §5.2.

pit_rule: Each GradeDate must be a real YYYY-MM-DD <= observed_at ET date <= source_as_of <= as_of. A future-dated row is excluded and counted; an older-than-window row is counted out-of-window; malformed dates fail closed.

emission_fitness.note: Only a full-coverage clean-parse ticker emits a scored analyst signal. Missing/partial/failed/degraded rows become neutral excluded coverage and must not block emit.

date_format: as_of / GradeDate = YYYY-MM-DD (ASCII, real calendar); observed_at = tz-aware RFC3339 date-time
consumer_note: Produces the same resolved grade actions shape as the FMP resolver. Downstream consumers stay provider-agnostic and must not combine yfinance and FMP rows for the same ticker.

duplicate_policy.note: Firm whitespace and case variants are one firm; a repeated composite row fails closed instead of inflating net or distinct-firm counts.

checked_empty_note: A full/ok ticker with zero in-window rows emits checked_no_recent_activity so checked-neutral is distinct from never queried.
